The following events took place in '''100 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Dowager Queen/Legends|''Dowager Queen'']] crashed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SoT">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> The planet was recolonized by [[Mining/Legends|miners]] who soon turned to [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farming]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TEA105">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*The corporate wing of the [[Bakur Memorial Building]] was built on [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. {{Circa}}
*[[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]] were first deployed. {{Circa}}
*The [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] colonized [[Kalakar Six]] from [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
*The [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] defended [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] from invaders.
